newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Goody's says 96 profit up 30.4pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek Goody's says 96 profit up 30.4pct.

text.p: Fast-food chain Goody's said its 1996 pretax profits rose 30.4 percent to 3.0 billion drachmas from 2.3 billion in 1995, company executives told institutional investors.
In 1997 the firm expects a further 13.3 percent increase in pretax profit to 3.4 billion drachmas and a rise of 20.5 percent to 4.1 billion in 1998.
In 1996 turnover also rose 6.7 percent to 19 billion drachmas from 17.8 billion in 1995. The company expects 1997 turnover to rise to 23.0 billion drachmas and projects 28 billion for 1998.

Goody's ranks sixth among the 12 biggest fast food chains in Europe and is the fastest expanding chain in Greece with 102 restaurants against McDonald's 34, executives said. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
